Home.title: WorkshopOS
Home.subtitle: An AI-first, bilingual platform for running a workshop business — built under human approval.
Home.sampleBody: Space is the primary layout tool; density is earned, never default. Hairline rules organize content instead of boxes and shadows. One accent color, used sparingly and precisely.
Home.signInPrompt: Sign in to reach the copilot and the approval queue.

Auth.heading: Sign in
Auth.subtitle: We email you a one-time link — no password.
Auth.linkSent: Check your email for a sign-in link.
Auth.devLinkNote: Dev mode: use this link to sign in.
Auth.invalidLink: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired.
Auth.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Copilot.greeting: Hi {name} — I'm your AI copilot. Describe what you'd like to do.
Copilot.heading: Copilot
Copilot.subtitle: Describe intent in plain language. Actions that change things are proposed first and wait for your approval.
Copilot.planEmpty: No plan yet. Send a command to see the proposed actions.
Copilot.notRecognized: I can only run "ping" in this milestone. Try: ping the workshop system.
Copilot.resultPong: Pong — the system answered in both languages.

Approvals.heading: Approval queue
Approvals.subtitle: Every AI action is logged to the ledger before it runs. Approve-tier actions wait here.
